300.title: Gunman with far-right views who killed 6 in Poland shooting rampage dies in hospital, police say
300.summary: The man who opened fire in a public square, killing six people in a suspected far-right terror attack in Kraków, Poland, has died, police said early Monday. The attacker had trained at a local shooting club, which said in a statement that he “was never trained in our club in the areas of dynamic, tactical or combat shooting.” Four women and two men were killed in the shooting.
300.body: The man who opened fire in a public square, killing six people in a suspected far-right terror attack in Kraków, Poland, has died, police said early Monday. The man, 24, was shot by police during Saturday’s midday rampage in Main Market Square, the historic center of Poland’s second-largest city. The attacker had trained at a local shooting club, which said in a statement that he “was never trained in our club in the areas of dynamic, tactical or combat shooting.” Four women and two men were killed in the shooting. The two police officers who stopped the gunman, in actions authorities hailed as heroic, remain in the hospital.

600.title: Poland's Linette rallies to win fourth career title at Chennai Open
600.summary: Poland's Magda Linette came from a set down to beat Indonesia's Janice Tjen 5-7, 6-1, 6-4 on Monday and win the WTA 250 tournament in Chennai, claiming the fourth singles title of her career. The 34-year-old, who reached the Australian Open semi-finals in 2023 and climbed to a career-high 19th in the world rankings, had not won a tournament since lifting the Prague Open title in July 2024.
600.body: Poland's Magda Linette came from a set down to beat Indonesia's Janice Tjen 5-7, 6-1, 6-4 on Monday and win the WTA 250 tournament in Chennai, claiming the fourth singles title of her career. The 34-year-old, who reached the Australian Open semi-finals in 2023 and climbed to a career-high 19th in the world rankings, had not won a tournament since lifting the Prague Open title in July 2024. The third-seeded Pole overcame top seed Tjen, the defending champion, after nearly three hours of play. Linette had previously reached the Chennai final in 2022 but lost to Czech player Linda Fruhvirtova.
